description: This file contains Rust source code for testing the DataBroker component using the Cucumber testing framework. It defines various step implementations for starting the server, setting, getting, and asserting values, as well as handling authorization and error checking within the test suite. The code interacts with the DataBroker's client API and simulates test scenarios as outlined in feature files.
external_methods: cucumber::{cli, gherkin::Step, given, then, when, writer, World as _}

methods.name: get_data_entries_from_table( step: &Step, ) -> Vec<( String, broker::DataType, broker::ChangeType, broker::EntryType, )>
methods.description: Parses a Cucumber step table to extract data entries with their associated types and change modes.

methods.name: start_databroker_server(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, auth: String, step: &Step)
methods.description: Starts a DataBroker server with specified authorization mode and initial data entries based on a Cucumber step.

methods.name: a_known_data_entry_has_value( w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, path: String, data_type: DataType, value_type: ValueType, value: String, )
methods.description: Sets a data entry to a specified value and verifies success.

methods.name: authorize_client(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, scope: String)
methods.description: Uses a token with specific scope to authorize the DataBroker client.

methods.name: set_value( w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, value_type: ValueType, path: String, data_type: DataType, value: String, )
methods.description: Sets a value of a specified data point for the client, with support for target and current values.

methods.name: get_value(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, value_type: ValueType, path: String)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified data point for the client.

methods.name: assert_value( w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, value_type: ValueType, path: String, expected_value: String, expected_type: DataType, )
methods.description: Asserts that the retrieved value matches the expected value and data type.

methods.name: assert_value_is_unspecified(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, value_type: ValueType, path: String)
methods.description: Checks that a data point's value is not specified.

methods.name: assert_value_not_found(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld)
methods.description: Verifies that the response indicates the value was not found (HTTP 404).

methods.name: assert_set_request_failure(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, _path: String, expected_error_code: u32)
methods.description: Checks that a set request failed with a specific error code.

methods.name: assert_request_failure(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld, expected_status_code: i32)
methods.description: Checks that an operation failed with the expected gRPC status code.

methods.name: assert_set_succeeds(w: &mut DataBrokerWorld)
methods.description: Verifies that the last set operation was successful.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point for running the Cucumber test suite with asynchronously executed steps.
